Marta (CS): weekly health check for CrestaThera's dedicated pool (cresta-prod). Overnight spike to ~93-96% saturation for ~6h, p50 latency regressed 150ms -> 280ms around 03:10 UTC, error-rate ticked 0.3% -> 1.2%. Spend +12% vs baseline.
Jon (Ops): yikes. queue depth and any internal jobs?
Marta (CS): queue depth peaked 44, 3h rolling avg 18. They kicked a batch of onboarding evals + an internal retrain at roughly the same time.
util-bot: [alert] pool:cresta-prod saturation >90% for 6h 14suggestion: consider +1 reserved unit or throttle non-critical queues
Eli (SRE): checking scheduler logs. there are a handful of long-seq retrain jobs without preemptible=true starting 03:06Z. snippet:
```
2026-06-12T03:06:12Z cresta-prod GPU2 load 95% seq_len=2048 batch=2
2026-06-12T03:06:13Z job retrain id=rt-214 owner=ml-pipeline queue=retrain-runner
```
Jon (Ops): that explains the queue pileup. retrain-runner currently lowpri but not preemptible. quick mitigation: flip retrain-runner to preemptible and add a soft max_concurrent for onboarding-evals.
Marta (CS): customer mentioned onboarding evals were scheduled by their product team for a demo tomorrow. Priya, want me to hold off contacting them until you weigh in?
Priya (AM): I'll reach out after we implement quick mitigations. want to propose (A) move onboarding evals to off-peak 08:00-14:00 UTC, (B) temporary +1 reserved unit for 48h. will include cost delta.
Eli (SRE): applying preemptible flag now. PATCH:
```
PATCH /pools/cresta-prod/config
{ "job_priority_override": { "queue": "retrain-runner", "priority": "background", "preemptible": true } }
```
Eli (SRE): patch applied. also added soft limiter for onboarding-evals: max_concurrent=6 (scheduler-level).
Jon (Ops): monitoring: queue depth down 44 -> 12 in 7m. GPU saturation dropped to ~64%. p50 latency trending back toward baseline. :thumbsup:
util-bot: [info] autoscale suggestion: +1 reserved unit would reduce saturation to ~48% but adds ~24 reserved GPU hours/day to commitment
Marta (CS): tagging renewal-risk if this pattern recurs prior to their renewal review next month. I'll add a note in the weekly account doc.
Priya (AM): pinging Cresta infra lead in #accounts-cresta with proposal. scheduling a quick sync for tomorrow 10:00 UTC to lock the onboarding window. will post customer ack here.
Jon (Ops): action items: 1) keep retrain-runner preemptible (owner: Eli, ETA 30m), 2) enforce soft quota for onboarding-evals (owner: Jon, ETA 24h), 3) decision on +1 reserve (owner: Priya/Marta, ETA 3h).
Eli (SRE): will keep an eye on error-rate and latency for the next 24h, reopen thread if uptick >1% or p50 >250ms.
Marta (CS): thanks team. Priya 11 paste customer response and I'll close the loop in the account notes. Reopen if anything flares. :eyes:
